minimizationPolicy.freshLoadCaretAffinity: after a strict O1 setup failure adjacent to an incomplete Live Preview asterisk delimiter, retain the shortest observed suffix beginning on an active line before that delimiter was produced; require a new strict O1 replay before certification
minimizationPolicy.oneActionMinimality: Target action is required to produce its action-trace observation; no proper non-empty action subsequence exists.
minimizationPolicy.statefulAction: retain the shortest contiguous suffix spanning both the O1-restored state and the aligned prior state restored by V1, so an incorrect merge/split boundary remains reproducible; Redo retains that edit suffix plus Undo/Redo
